messages:
Ana (partnerships): Quick heads-up — NovaEdge wants a joint perf/W announcement for their A100X board + Redwood runtime. Target window: first week of next month. Need alignment on: measurement rig, kernel/driver patches (if any), telemetry schema, reproducibility checklist, and press embargo dates. Draft plan below; please flag gaps.

Devon (eng-runtime): Thanks — can we lock the model/config matrix? My suggestion: open-source model 'gpt-small-v1' (baseline) and a 30B optimized shard for throughput curve. Key knobs: seq_len 2048, batch sizes 1/4/8, kv-cache warmed, quant q4_0/q8_0. Kernel branch: redwood/novaedge-a100x-tune (WIP). Example run command for QA:```bash
run_bench --model gpt-small-v1 --seq 2048 --batch 8 --quant q4_0 --warm 1000 --log /tmp/bench.log
```Will push the branch by EOD.

Ravi (perf): Proposed perf matrix (short):
- Metrics: tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency, node power (W) sampled at 1s, tokens/joule (tokens/sec divided by watts), tail CPU/GPU temp.
- Run plan: cold start, warmed (1k tokens), sustained 30m steady-state for throughput.
- Acceptance criteria for publish: >= 10k tokens/sec @ batch8 and >3.2 tokens/joule sustained. If below, mark as "engineering caveat" and show trade-offs.
Also we need a reproducibility hash: git commit, kernel config, pkgs + docker image sha.

Linh (NovaEdge): We can run the matrix on our lab rigs. Notes: power telemetry provided via IPMI + our neon-power client (samples/sec=1). We will share a sanitized dataset for model runs to avoid PII. Thermal caveat — some 2U configs hit thermal throttle after ~45m at peak clocks; we'll annotate any throttling windows. We'll ingest your redwood/novaedge branch once available. Timeline: runs done within 5 business days of branch push.

Ana (partnerships): Good — for press: Maya, can you weigh in on embargo cadence? We want a joint marketplace listing published same day as announcement. Also need a short co-authored technical note (1 page) summarizing methodology and results.

Maya (pressops): Sounds fine. Embargo plan suggestion: internal embargo until test artifacts reviewed + legal sign-off (3 business days), public announce on Tuesday morning (ET) to coordinate with NovaEdge PR. PressOps can draft the 1-page note once Ravi/Devon provide the final numbers and the reproducibility block. Who owns the marketplace blurb?

Devon (eng-runtime): We can draft the marketplace blurb and include: verified model configs, expected throughput/watt ranges, supported kernel/firmware versions, and a "notes" section for thermal/scale caveats. I'll prepare a draft after we merge the branch.

pressbot: Automated reminder — please upload bench logs + docker image sha to the shared S3 bucket: s3://redwood-partners/novaedge-a100x/ by 1718008600.

Ravi (perf): A couple of practical checks before runs: 1) ensure powercap is disabled for fairness, 2) confirm DVFS table used, 3) run two repeats (different seeds) and report median. I'll prepare the analysis notebook and the plotting script.

Linh (NovaEdge): Confirmed on powercap/DVFS. We'll run two repeats and include raw power traces. Also we'll attach ipmi logs + chassis serials (sanitized).

Ana (partnerships): Action items:
- Devon: push branch + draft marketplace blurb (due in 24h).
- Linh: run matrix and upload logs to s3 (due in 5bd).
- Ravi: analysis notebook + 1-page methodology draft (due in 3bd).
- Maya: prepare embargo timeline + PR skeleton (due in 3bd).
Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept the tasks or :eyes: if you need more time.

Devon (eng-runtime): :thumbsup: pushing branch now.

Ravi (perf): :eyes: might need 1 extra day if runs show repeat variance >5%.

Linh (NovaEdge): :thumbsup: running lab tomorrow morning (PT).

Maya (pressops): :thumbsup: will draft calendar hold and PR skeleton.
